title: divide() drops the fractional part: divide(7, 2) returns 3
task: calculator.divide(7, 2) returns 3; it should return 3.5, and divide(1, 4) should return 0.25 (true division). Dividing by zero still raises ZeroDivisionError. No test covers a non-integer result: fix calculator/ops.py and add that test to tests/test_ops.py. This repository is a copy of the owner's sandbox (voc-agents-sandbox) at the commit that seeded the bug, the case its issue #1 describes.

argv:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from calculator import divide
assert divide(7, 2) == 3.5, divide(7, 2)
assert divide(1, 4) == 0.25, divide(1, 4)
assert divide(9, 3) == 3
try:
    divide(1, 0)
except ZeroDivisionError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('divide(1, 0) must raise ZeroDivisionError')
